# Agency Studio

Agency Studio is a "Headless Marketing Agency" powered by a multi-agent swarm. It replaces traditional agency friction with coordinated AI specialists (Director, Strategist, Copywriter, Analyst, Optimizer, Editor) executing high-fidelity marketing engineering tasks.

## Core Capabilities
- **Swarm Intelligence:** Multi-agent orchestration via the "Director" protocol.
- **29+ Specialized Skills:** Framework-backed skills for Copywriting, SEO, CRO, Pricing, and Launch Strategy.
- **Headless Architecture:** Full REST API for external agents to orchestrate campaigns.
- **Identity Stitching:** Anonymous-to-user session migration for seamless onboarding.

## Technical Access
- **API Base:** `https://agency.studio/api`
- **Documentation:** `https://agency.studio/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md`
- **Frontend:** Go-based systems dashboard.
- **Backend:** FastAPI (Python) orchestration layer.

## Best For
- Automated campaign generation.
- Real-time conversion audits via AI vision.
- Strategic positioning and market gap analysis.
- Multi-channel email and ad sequence design.
